author: GameTrailers
description: Check out gameplay from Shrot in this trailer for the upcoming fast, funny, and unapologetically stupid first-person boomer shooter where a Slavic trucker gets stuck in an alien apocalypse and handles it the only way he knows how: with beer, cigarettes, and unresolved anger issues. Shrot will be available on PC in 2027. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Shrot - Official Demo Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
The arcade-style classic is back - and it's leveling up. Take a look at gameplay from Backyard Baseball in this new trailer for the upcoming arcade baseball game, as the sports franchise from the '90s makes a return with this new game, featuring enhanced gameplay, new game modes, and all the humor and charm of the original. Backyard Baseball will be available on PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on July 9, 2026.

#IGN #IGNLive #SummerOfGaming
title: Backyard Baseball Official Gameplay Trailer - IGN Live 2026

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Into The Wind announcement trailer for this upcoming cozy adventure game, where you take to the skies on their sentient motorcycle-plane companion Ermes as they explore the magical Adriatic islands of Santa Rosa. Into the Wind will be available on PC.

In the Studio Ghibli-inspired world of Into the Wind, players inherit their uncle Umberto's delivery firm as they attempt to solve the mystery of his disappearance. Along the way, they'll make friends with the island's colourful residents, customise their bike and home, battle rowdy air pirates and discover the freedom of life among the clouds in a heartfelt adventure inspired by the joy of the journey itself.
title: Into the Wind - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Talorim the Mage and see the character in action in this latest To Kill a God trailer for the upcoming action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god. To Kill a God is set in the Death Spiral, a cursed realm where warriors are trapped in endless cycles of death and rebirth. As a Traveler, your only hope is to escape, but first, you must slay the gods who guard the way out. Talorim the Mage is available now in the To Kill a God demo on Steam. To Kill a God will be available on PC in 2026.
title: To Kill A God - Official Talorim Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the Time Strike announcement trailer for this upcoming single-player FPS that gives you maximum control. The Time Strike announcement trailer showcases gameplay and more of what you can expect from this game by the creators of Frozen Synapse. Stop time to dodge projectiles, rip down walls, line up a headshot, and flip flying debris into hapless enemies. Time Strike will be available on PC in 2027.
title: Time Strike - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at gameplay from AfterQuest in this trailer for the upcoming fast-paced roguelite RPG with tactical, turn-based combat. Build your party by choosing three heroes from a growing roster, experiment with endless build combinations, and experience a character-driven story where defeat only makes you stronger. AfterQuest will be available on PC.
title: AfterQuest - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Virtue? That’s for suckers. But fame? Priceless. Watch the latest Happy Bastards trailer to see gameplay from this upcoming open-world tactical RPG. Assemble unruly bastards into a mercenary squad and build your legend through reckless adventuring, bloody fights, lucrative looting, and dirty dealings. Choose your battles, and your allies, in this irreverent open-world tactical RPG. Happy Bastards will be available on PC. A combat demo is out now on Steam.
title: Happy Bastards - Official Combat Demo Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Don't miss this new look at We Are So Cooked, the 4-player co-op physics stealth comedy game from Dwarven Brothers. 
Work together to hide a body, taking care to not run into hunters, screamers or get picked up by the cameras! Use items in the environment to distract and incapictate potential witnesses to hide the body and get home scott-free! 
We Are So Cooked will be available for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam, Epic Games Store), and Xbox Series X|S in 2026.
title: We Are So Cooked - Official IGS Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the Gone Feral announcement trailer for this upcoming co-op roguelike assassination game where you stalk your victims through 1980s America. Improvise brutal kills with everyday objects, terrorize your targets, and get revenge solo or with friends. Hunt across iconic horror locations such as a summer camp, small town, farm, and a sprawling mansion. Gone Feral will be available on PC.
title: Gone Feral - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Hack, slash, and cast your way through a haunted kingdom brimming with secrets where no two builds are ever the same. Watch the Cursemark launch trailer for this action roguelite game. As a cursed mage-knight you will unlock devastating spells, equip ability-transforming runes, and reforge your curse on the path to victory or death in this fantasy action roguelite. Cursemark is out now on Steam.
title: Cursemark - Official Launch Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster gets a new trailer and a release date announcement. Watch the latest Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster trailer for this upcoming classic hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania action game to see gameplay, combat, enemies, and more. In Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster, it's time for revenge! Use your Beastmaster skills to unleash your inner beast, fight with your heart-devouring sword and end the threat to Arborea, you decide the ending. Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster will be available on Steam, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 5 (PS5), and Xbox Series X/S on September 9, 2026.
title: Barbarian Saga: The Beastmaster - Release Date Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Fortnite 'Get Well Soon Jonesy' teaser trailer. Chapter 7 Season 3 of Fortnite is out now.
title: Fortnite - Official Get Well Soon Jonesy Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Sunset Survival: Miami is a just-announced top-down PvE survival shooter. Collect vital resources, find powerful equipment, and fight off diverse mutant enemies. Wishlist it on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4747280/Sunset_Survival_Miami/

#SunsetSurvivalMiami #Gaming #IGN
title: Sunset Survival: Miami - Official Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Check out the Halo: Campaign Evolved cinematic story trailer. After crash landing on a mysterious ringworld known as Halo, the Master Chief is tasked with defending humanity against an overwhelming alien force: the Covenant. With the help of his AI companion Cortana, the Chief must uncover Halo’s dark secrets and fight to avert the annihilation of all life in the galaxy.

Halo: Campaign Evolved will be available on Xbox Series X|S, PC, and PlayStation 5 (PS5) on July 28, 2026. Pre-orders of the Premium Edition or Collector’s Edition grant up to 5 days early access beginning July 23, 2026.
title: Halo: Campaign Evolved - Official Cinematic Story Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Challenge deadly enemies and discover powerful augments in 2XKO's new PVE game mode, The Climb. Watch the latest 2XKO trailer for the free-to-play fighting game from Riot Games, to see what to expect with The Climb PVE game mode. Fight 2v2, adapt your strategy, and unlock PVE-only abilities in each new encounter. Every run is unique. Play solo or team up with a friend and ascend to the top. Complete beginner, intermediate, and advanced difficulty levels with each champion to earn rewards, including exclusive chromas. The Climb will be playable beginning June 9 in 2XKO.
title: 2XKO - Official The Climb: New PVE Mode Reveal Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Welcome back to South Town! With the upcoming release of Kenshiro in June, Fatal Fury City of the Wolves is coming to an end of the 2nd Season of content and seems to be gearing up for a third! This animated teaser strongly hints that Real Bout Fatal Fury 2 boxer Rick Strowd will be joining the roster in Season 3! 

Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Season 3 Animated Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description: Meet Lohen and get to know the character in this latest Genshin Impact trailer for the action RPG. Genshin Impact is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, iOS, Android, and PC.
title: Genshin Impact - Official 'Lohen: A Masterpiece' Character Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Learn about the sprites before heading into Chapter 7 Season 3 of Fortnite. Meet the Sprites and see how they'll aid you in this latest Fortnite trailer.
title: Fortnite - Official 'Meet The Sprites' Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Watch the Jurassic World Evolution 3 Undisclosed Location teaser for the dinosaur park simulation game. Jurassic World Evolution 3 is available now for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).
title: Jurassic World Evolution 3 - Official Undisclosed Location Teaser

author: GameTrailers
description:
Watch the latest Samson trailer to see what's coming with the free content update, Welcome to The Pit. The Welcome to The Pit update brings a new area of the map called the Lowline Circuit Race Track, vehicle customization, taxi gigs, and new jobs to the action-adventure game. The Welcome to The Pit update for Samson will be available on PC on June 9, 2026.

Samson returns to Tyndalston, a city that shaped him hard, where every fight is close and every escape is earned. He owes dangerous people more than he can pay, and they’re using his sister to force his hand. The clock is ticking. The only way out is through anyone who stands in his way.
title: Samson - Official 'Welcome To The Pit' Free Update Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the Duskers 2.0 teaser trailer for this upcoming sequel to developer Misfits Attic's roguelike game, Duskers. In Duskers 2.0, scavenge derelict spacecraft with your drones via a command-line interface, navigating past whatever is still alive in the dark. Find survivors frozen in cryostasis and piece together their stories. Nothing you do is forgotten. Each run builds toward a new colony, and over time you'll see how your previous outposts have fared. Who survived, who didn't, and how well you prepared them. 

Duskers 2.0, created by Misfits Attic in partnership with developer Stray Signal, will be available in Early Access on Steam.
title: Duskers 2.0 - Official Teaser Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: The development team at The Coalition talks about rebuilding Gears of War from the ground up for E-Day. The massive new city, Kalona, is the setting of destruction like never before. Gears of War: E-Day comes to Xbox on October 6, 2026.
title: Gears of War: E-Day - Development Overview | Xbox Games Showcase 2026
